scopeTip.hq: System admin: sees and acts on data of every production org
scopeTip.factory: Can only view and act on data of the authorized production orgs
scopeTip.queryFactory: Can only look up data of the authorized production orgs, and cannot take any action

common.exportTruncated: More than {limit} rows match; only the first {limit} rows will be exported. Continue?

login.title: Sign in
login.lead: HQ generates SNs per production order material line and allocates them to the order's production org; MES orgs get them pushed, and every org can download them on the SN export page. SNs never repeat within a PI.
login.point1: Preview before generating; stale when the max changes
login.point2: Delivery batches with receipts, idempotent by batch No.
login.point3: Every bill and org transfer is audited
login.hint: Accounts are created by the system administrator with the company employee No.; ask the system administrator for your password.

password.title: Change password
password.relogin: After the change every page signed in with this account signs out; sign in again with the new password.
password.policy: 8–64 characters with both letters and digits; only letters, digits and ! {'@'} # $ & *

allocate.title: SN allocation
allocate.desc: Allocate generated SNs to the order's production org: MES orgs get them pushed in batches automatically and confirm each batch, and an interrupted push can be resumed; every allocated SN can be downloaded on the “SN export” page. Allocate a whole PI or the ticked lines.
allocate.pickPi: Pick a PI on the left
allocate.toGenerate: {n} more to generate · go to generation
allocate.linesHint: Tick lines as the scope, nothing ticked = whole PI; a line's SNs go together to the order's production org
allocate.skippedN: {n} bills will be skipped (frozen, unapproved or suspended)
allocate.allocConfirmPush: Allocate {n} SNs? The MES part will be pushed in {m} batches automatically.
allocate.allocSkipped: {n} bills were skipped (frozen, unapproved or suspended)
allocate.acquireNote: Orgs without MES download their SNs on the SN export page:

audit.title: Audit trail
audit.retention: Records stay online for {days} days, then move to the archive month by month;

batch.confirmTip: Use only when MES confirms in writing that everything was processed but cannot send a receipt: the batch becomes succeeded (confirmed manually) and is not retried; SNs of a delivery batch become pushed.
batch.voidTip: Only for batches MES has not processed: SNs of a delivery batch go back to to-push (unbatched) and are re-batched; a transfer-out batch is rebuilt from its items and pushed automatically.
batch.basisPlaceholder: e.g. written confirmation from MES, at most 500 characters

dashboard.title: Hello, {name}
dashboard.delayNote: In-progress figures may lag by a few seconds
dashboard.recentFailures: Recent push failures and missing receipts
dashboard.pullNoReceipt: Pulled by MES but no receipt within the alert time

export.title: SN export
export.desc: SNs appear here, per “production org + PI + bill”, as soon as they are allocated to a production org, with or without MES. Export and MES push / pull are independent: push progress is not shown, and a failed push does not block export. Open the detail to see every SN one by one, or download xlsx directly (columns: PI, bill, material, SN); exporting is read-only and repeatable and does not change SN status.
export.rule: SNs can be exported as soon as they are allocated (unallocated ones are not shown), whether or not they were pushed successfully; a download contains every SN of the bill in that org at download time.

factories.title: Production orgs
factories.desc: Production org master data comes only from Kingdee and is synced once when this page opens; this system only maintains each org's MES integration settings. SN ownership follows the org code on the order; names are for display only.
factories.name: Name
factories.batchSizeHint: Also the cap for batches built on MES pull
factories.seconds: seconds; on timeout the batch stays unconfirmed and retries after 1 / 5 / 15 min
factories.concurrencyHint: Push tasks running at once (across PIs); the rest queue
factories.tzHint: Time zone for page times and “today” statistics of this org's accounts
factories.enabledEditHint: Integration is on: after changing the endpoint, auth type, credential or gzip compression, the new settings must pass the connection test before saving
factories.gzipHint: Plain JSON by default; when on, the push request body is gzip-compressed (with Content-Encoding: gzip) and MES must support it
factories.credentialKeep: Set; leave empty to keep the stored credential
factories.credentialHint: Used when SN calls MES; stored encrypted and never shown; separate from the interface account MES uses to call this system
factories.enableBlocked: Fill in the endpoint and credential and pass the connection test first (under MES settings)
factories.enableEffect: After turning on, {n} allocated SNs of this org become to-push (not batched) and are not pushed automatically; resume pushing on the allocation page or let MES pull them.
factories.disableEffect: After turning off, {n} to-push (not batched) SNs of this org become allocated (still downloadable on SN export); pushed and acquired SNs stay as they are, and the endpoint and credential are kept (transfer-outs still get pushed).
factories.disableBlocked: Unfinished pushes remain; cannot turn off
factories.disableBlockedHint: Resume pushing or wait for MES receipts first; if MES is out of service, confirm or void the remaining batches manually under delivery batches.
factories.disableHint: Production orgs disabled in Kingdee cannot be bound to accounts or chosen as transfer targets; SNs already allocated to them can still be exported, pushed, pulled and transferred out.

generate.title: SN generation
generate.desc: Generate SNs per PI: complete the SN rule and attachment item of each material line, then tick lines and generate (each line gets its whole quota at once, all SNs share the PI's serial); revoking is also per line, from the end of the serial backwards. Generated SNs are allocated on the “SN allocation” page.
generate.recentOnly: Only the latest {n} pages are listed; search for older PIs
generate.capped: At most {n} PIs are fetched ({n}+); narrow down with search
generate.todoNote: Lines become generatable once fixed; you can also tick only the ready lines and generate them first
generate.ruleNote: Line rules apply in the order “line pick > PI binding > customer default”
generate.noPiRule: No rule bound to this PI; each material line can pick its own
generate.noCustomerRule: No rule bound to the customer (customer binding is set via the interface only)
generate.pickLibRule: Pick a library rule to bind to this PI
generate.unbindPiConfirm: After unbinding the rule becomes a general template; lines that already picked a rule are not affected. Unbind?
generate.unbindCustomerConfirm: Unbind the rule of customer {customer}? The rule becomes a general template.
generate.templateNote: The customer rule is only a template: enter a new prefix to derive a version owned by this PI
generate.pickForNeeded: Pick a rule for these lines

plan.CLAIM: Will be claimed by this PI

rule.searchLib: Search by code, name or category
rule.prefixNeeded: This rule version is already used by PI {pi}; enter a new prefix for this PI and a new version with the same format will be created
rule.customNote: Format is “prefix + PI serial + separator + line length + separator + line unit + suffix”, any characters allowed; after a successful generation it is saved to the library and assigned to this PI; nothing is kept if generation fails or is canceled.
rule.changeNote: Some selected lines already have SNs: existing SNs stay, the serial continues, and later SNs use the new format
rule.changeConfirm: Some selected lines already have SNs. Change the rule?

generate.lengthDefaultTip: Length is optional; when empty, generation uses the default 000. It is written into the SN as text (000, 001, 002 and so on are all fine)
generate.lockAllocated: Allocated, can no longer be changed
generate.ownTip: Generated by this bill {own}; generated (incl. transfers) {gen}
generate.noLines: This bill is no longer in the snapshot; only its SNs can be viewed
generate.unitChineseTip: The Kingdee unit “{k3}” is Chinese; when the rule includes the unit, enter a unit without Chinese (e.g. M, m, L) before generating; the value is not written back to Kingdee
generate.unitEmptyTip: The Kingdee unit is empty; when the rule includes the unit, enter a unit without Chinese (e.g. M, m, L) before generating; the value is not written back to Kingdee
generate.unitChinese: The unit cannot contain Chinese characters; enter e.g. M, m, L
generate.lengthChineseTip: The Kingdee length “{k3}” contains Chinese characters; change it to one without Chinese (e.g. 50) before generating; the value is not written back to Kingdee
generate.lengthChinese: The length cannot contain Chinese characters
generate.genCanceled: Generation canceled; all written SNs were deleted
generate.runNote: Running in the background; closing the page is fine; canceling deletes written SNs
generate.cancelConfirm: Canceling deletes all written SNs and restores the PI max and generated counts. Cancel?
generate.toAllocate: {n} SNs to allocate · go to SN allocation
generate.selHint: Tick bills (whole bill, SNs follow the tick order) or material lines (SNs follow the click order) as the scope for generating; the same ticks drive bulk rule changes and revoking. Nothing ticked = the whole PI
generate.jobsNote: Records are read-only; to revoke a whole generation, click “Tick its lines”, then “Revoke (selected)” at the bottom.
generate.revokeConfigTip: Revoke config: the line's selected rule and manually filled attachment item and length are reset
generate.revokeConfigConfirm: Revoke the configuration of {n} material lines: their selected rule falls back to the PI / customer default, manually filled attachment items are cleared, and manually filled lengths return to the Kingdee value or the default 000.
generate.unlock: Over the default per-run limit {limit}; lift it
generate.genNote: Each line gets its whole quota at once; up to {n} SNs are generated right away, more run in the background with progress. The preview is yours only, expires at {time} and can be used once.
generate.lockGenerated: Already generated, cannot be changed; while the SNs are unallocated, revoke this line, change it and generate again
generate.revokeConfirm: Revoke these {m} material lines, {n} SNs, from the end of the serial backwards: the SNs are deleted, the PI max and generated counts are rolled back, and the lines' attachment item and length become editable again.
generate.revokeExtra: {n} of them come after the selected lines in the serial and must be revoked too.
generate.revokeOwnBad: Its SNs are allocated or transferred; cannot revoke
generate.revokeLaterBad: A line after it in the serial is allocated or transferred; cannot revoke
generate.revokeWithLater: Revoked from the end of the serial: {n} lines together with those after it
generate.revokeTail: Last line in the serial; can be revoked directly

orders.title: Production order snapshot
orders.desc: Approved Kingdee production orders, stored per material line (bill + line No.). Left: totals per bill; right: material lines. Bills without a customer are shown and processed as usual.
orders.rebuildConfirm: A full rebuild fetches all approved Kingdee production orders and replaces the snapshot as a whole (the old snapshot is kept on failure); it may take long for large data. Use it for the first import or when the snapshot seems inconsistent with Kingdee. Continue?
orders.compareDone: Compare sync done: {replaced} replaced, {removed} removed, {rows} lines

outcome.NOT_APPROVED: Bill {bill} is not approved in Kingdee (status {status}); removed from the snapshot
outcome.NOT_APPROVED_NEW: Bill {bill} is not approved in Kingdee (status {status}); not added to the snapshot

orders.syncFailed: The last compare sync failed ({time}): {msg}; the list shows the old snapshot
orders.pick: Pick a bill on the left
orders.attachConflict: Kingdee now has {k3} (entered {manual}); generation uses the Kingdee value
orders.attachInvalid: Attachment item cannot be empty, at most 64 characters
orders.unitChineseTip: The unit is Chinese; when the rule includes the unit, enter a unit without Chinese (e.g. M, m, L) on the SN generation page before generating
orders.lengthChineseTip: The length contains Chinese characters; change it to one without Chinese on the SN generation page before generating

actionHint.CONFIRM: Confirm the change of bill {bill}: frozen generation and suspended delivery are lifted, and later generation and allocation follow the current snapshot. Allocated SNs are not moved automatically; transfer them to another org first if needed. Continue?
actionHint.UNRELATED: Confirm the lost material line of bill {bill} is unrelated to the new lines: its generated count stays, and new lines can be generated normally. Continue?

orders.voidHint: Confirm the bill is actually voided in Kingdee: suspension is lifted, SNs to allocate go to the production org recorded at generation, allocated SNs are delivered as usual, and the bill is no longer re-checked. Enter the reason.
orders.mapHint: The generated count of lost line {seq} (former material {material}) of bill {bill} is merged into the line chosen below, and its SNs move to that line; SNs already delivered to MES are re-pushed as reassignments.

query.title: SN query
query.desc: Read-only lookup of SN details, delivery batches (push, pull, transfer-out), acquire batches and delivery alerts, filtered by the production orgs your account can see; SNs cannot be moved from this page.
query.piAllTip: Read-only view of this PI's SNs across production orgs
query.seqRangeTip: A PI is required for a serial range; both ends are inclusive, leaving one end empty means unbounded; only serials generated by this PI are searched.
query.rangeMissing: The range should have {expected}; {n} are not in the results (in other orgs, transferred or not generated)
query.rangeFull: Every SN of the range is in the results
query.resendTip: The SN revision becomes max(ours, MES) + 1 and is pushed to the MES holder org as a reassignment.

rules.title: Rule library
rules.desc: Maintain SN rules: SN = prefix + serial within the PI (zero-padded) + separator + length (zero-padded, optional) + separator + unit (optional) + suffix, any characters allowed. Rules are only maintained here; choosing rules for material lines and binding a PI happen on the generation page; customer bindings can only be set via the API and are shown read-only under “Bindings”.
rules.ownerHint: Empty = global rule: every org may use it, only the system administrator can modify or delete it
rules.ownerOperatorHint: The rule belongs to the chosen authorized org; only that org's accounts and the system administrator can see and modify it
rules.globalReadonly: Only the system administrator can modify or delete global rules; operators can only use them
rules.codeHint: 1–64 letters, digits, _ or -; cannot change later
rules.name: Name
rules.categoryHint: Only for filtering and recommendation; does not make the rule effective
rules.withLengthHint: SN contains the material line's length as text (000 when empty; lengths with Chinese must be edited on the generation page first)
rules.lengthPadHint: Pads the length with leading zeros to this width (5: 51.5 → 051.5); longer values are kept; 0 = no padding
rules.sepHint: Optional, at most 16 characters each, any characters
rules.withUnitHint: SN contains the material line's product unit (Kingdee FProductUnit as is; lines without a unit cannot be generated)
rules.prefixHint: Required, any characters (case-sensitive); must not equal any rule's prefix (old versions included). Sharing a leading part, e.g. SD and SDD, is allowed
rules.charsetHint: Leave empty for the default charset (its first character, 0, is used for padding); a custom one must not contain spaces and needs as many unique characters as the base
rules.hintIN_PLACE: The current version has never generated SNs: saving edits it in place
rules.hintNEW_VERSION: The current version has generated SNs: changing the format creates a new version with a new prefix, used only for SNs generated later
rules.hintUSED: The current version has generated SNs: changing only the name or category keeps the version
rules.deleteBlocked: Rules that generated SNs or are assigned to a PI cannot be deleted
rules.deleteConfirm: Delete rule {code} ({name}) and all its versions?

transfer.title: SN transfer

kindTip.BILL: For orders voided or split in Kingdee: SNs move to another production order and follow its org; SNs still to allocate may move too; effective at once.
kindTip.ORG: SNs move to another production org (may differ from the target bill's), limited to allocated SNs of the source org; transfer directly (effective at once) when both orgs are authorized, otherwise submit a request for an account authorized for both orgs to approve.

transfer.previewFirst: Preview first, then submit once the transferable count looks right
transfer.approveConfirm: Approve org transfer {no} ({n} SNs)? SNs are re-attached and pushed automatically.
transfer.rejectConfirm: Reject org transfer {no} ({n} SNs)? SNs go back to their previous status.
transfer.withdrawConfirm: Withdraw request {no}? SNs go back to their previous status.

blocked.TRANSFER_OUT_PENDING: Transfer-out unfinished; resume it on the original org transfer first

transfer.applyNote: After submitting, SNs become transfer-pending and cannot be pushed or pulled until approved (by the system admin or an operator authorized for both orgs); you may withdraw before that. MES is not notified meanwhile.
transfer.directNote: Direct transfer: both orgs must be authorized; SNs are re-attached at once, with reassign and transfer-out pushes as needed.
transfer.noMes: No MES: download on the SN export page
transfer.desc: Re-attach SNs to another production order or org; SN strings never change. Two kinds: bill transfer (for orders voided or split in Kingdee; SNs follow the target bill; effective at once) and org transfer (SNs move to another production org: direct when both orgs are authorized, otherwise a request approved by an account authorized for both). Both pick the source by PI → bill → material → single SN or range, and require target PI, bill, production org and material. MES is informed by automatic reassign / transfer-out pushes. Operators only act on SNs of their authorized orgs.

scopeTip.BILL: All SNs of this bill under the PI
scopeTip.MATERIAL: All SNs of this material code in the bill (all lines of the material)
scopeTip.RANGE: One SN or a contiguous range within the bill and material

transfer.noBillInPi: No bills of this PI in the snapshot
transfer.orgOfBill: Bill transfer: the target bill's org
transfer.orgFree: Defaults to the target bill's org; may be changed
transfer.rangeHint: Start only = single SN; start and end must be within the selected bill and material and share the same serial PI
transfer.applyConfirm: Request moving {n} SNs to {to} · PI {pi} · bill {bill}?
transfer.directConfirm: Move {n} SNs directly to {to} · PI {pi} · bill {bill}?
transfer.quotaUnchanged: When SNs change material line, generated and allocated counts move with them; the remaining quota does not change.

users.title: Accounts
users.desc: Only the system administrator can create, edit, disable and enable accounts and reset passwords; accounts are disabled, never deleted. MES interface accounts cannot sign in to pages; they send employee No. + secret directly on every MES API call.
users.empNoHint: 4–32 letters and digits; cannot change later
users.name: Name

roleHint.admin: The only system administrator: every production org, every function (including configuration and account management)
roleHint.operator: Authorized for one or more production orgs: production orders, SN generation, allocation, rule library (global rules are use-only), transfers, delivery handling, SN export and query
roleHint.auditor: Read-only; authorized for one or more production orgs: SN query and export, audit trail
roleHint.mes: Can only call the MES pull, receipt and read-only APIs of its org

users.lockedUntil: Too many failed secret checks; locked until {time}
users.disableConfirm: Disable account {emp} ({name})? It can no longer sign in or call the API, and can be re-enabled.
users.resetPrompt: New password for {emp} (pages signed in with it sign out; sign in again with the new password)
users.ipHint: IPs or CIDRs separated by commas; empty = any. When set, only requests from the list are accepted
users.mesFactoryHint: You can create the account and hand it to MES for joint testing before turning MES integration on; until then it can only pull transfer-out batches, submit receipts and run read-only queries
users.secretWillShow: A secret is generated on save; you can view or reset it any time
users.secretKeep: After closing, use “View secret” in the list to see it again, or “Reset secret” to generate a new one; hand it to the MES side and keep it safe
users.secretUsage: MES sends the header Authorization: Bearer <employee No.>:<secret> on every call; no token exchange.
users.resetSecretConfirm: Reset the secret of {emp}? The old secret stops working at once; MES must switch to the new secret.
